title: Settlement Basis, Shelf Pricing and Portfolio Bands: the Micro Market Tariff
content:
The commercial basis a micro market settles on, the shelf markup it prices at, the sales it is written against and the portfolio band it earns are all printed against the market format. This tariff is the printed source for every format in the Unattended Micro Market Program.

| Market format | Settlement basis | Management fee, USD each month | Commission paid back, per cent of sales | Shelf markup on landed cost, per cent | Monthly sales guarantee, USD | Shortfall share invoiced, per cent | Card processing passed through, per cent | Invoice raised on day |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooler & Snack Wall | commission | 0 | 8 | 38 | 1100 | 100 | 2.9 | 5 |
| Compact Micro Market | commission | 0 | 10 | 40 | 3200 | 95 | 2.75 | 8 |
| Standard Micro Market | subsidy true-up | 0 | 0 | 42 | 7800 | 90 | 2.6 | 10 |
| Fresh Food Micro Market | subsidy true-up | 0 | 0 | 45 | 15000 | 85 | 2.5 | 12 |
| Expanded Campus Micro Market | management fee | 1450 | 0 | 44 | 29000 | 80 | 2.35 | 15 |
| Smart Store Micro Market | management fee | 980 | 0 | 46 | 12000 | 90 | 2.45 | 18 |

## Portfolio band ladder printed against each format

Each format carries its own ladder of portfolio steps, read as the number of the client's micro market agreements against the percentage taken off.

| Market format | 1 agreement | 3 agreements | 6 agreements | 10 agreements |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooler & Snack Wall | 0 per cent | 0.75 per cent | 1.5 per cent | 2.25 per cent |
| Compact Micro Market | 0 per cent | 1 per cent | 2 per cent | 3 per cent |
| Standard Micro Market | 0 per cent | 1.25 per cent | 2.5 per cent | 3.75 per cent |
| Fresh Food Micro Market | 0 per cent | 1.5 per cent | 3 per cent | 4.5 per cent |
| Expanded Campus Micro Market | 0 per cent | 1.75 per cent | 3.5 per cent | 5.25 per cent |
| Smart Store Micro Market | 0 per cent | 2 per cent | 4 per cent | 6 per cent |

## Notes on reading the tariff

A format settling on commission pays the client back a share of sales and carries no management fee; a format settling on a management fee carries the fee printed in its column and pays no commission; a format settling on a subsidy true-up carries neither. The shelf markup is applied to landed product cost to set shelf prices, and the card processing percentage is passed through on employee card purchases.
